title: Cybersecurity Data Scientist
summary: Senior Data Scientist with 8+ years applying machine learning, NLP and GenAI to complex infrastructure and enterprise data across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps. Builds anomaly detection, clustering and classification models on network alarms and operational logs, and uses LLMs to summarise, extract and enrich unstructured data. Works in Python, SQL, PySpark and Databricks, and delivers insights through dashboards and monitored production models to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Security Alert Triage Pipeline
bullets: Built an alert triage pipeline for security operations that clusters related alerts with Sentence-BERT embeddings and scores their risk with LightGBM on asset and identity features.
Evaluated triage quality against analyst-labelled incidents, used an LLM to summarise each alert cluster, and ran the pipeline on Databricks with PySpark feeding Power BI dashboards.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Cybersecurity Data Scientist role at State Street. Much of my work has been finding signal in noisy infrastructure data: clustering network alarm floods back to their root event, detecting anomalies across telecom KPIs and making operational logs searchable. The common thread is turning raw telemetry into decisions people can act on.

Protecting a bank that safeguards the investments of millions of people depends on seeing risk early, and that is the kind of problem where careful data science earns its place. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Ireland together and settle there long term.

I would bring hands-on anomaly detection, NLP and GenAI experience to your security data. At Viavi my Sentence-BERT and DBSCAN alarm clustering improved classification by 73.5%, and an SLA breach prediction system using GPT-3.5 for root-cause analysis reduced downtime by 67%. Earlier I built log observability with Elasticsearch and Kibana.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. It has made me careful about building tools that people can trust and understand. I would be glad to talk about how I could support your cybersecurity team.
